emotional_tone: Calm, organized, trustworthy, and frictionless. Feels like structured paper rather than a sterile tech tool.

hierarchy.small_label: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.15em] font-bold text-[#78716C]

layout_and_spacing.spacing_system: Generous. p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped data views.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Cards and containers must use p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision. For tables, ensure wide padding in cells (px-6 py-4).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-6. Summary metrics use col-span-1. Charts or tables use col-span-2 or col-span-3.
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Flat Solid. bg-white with 1px border (#E7E5E4). No heavy drop shadows. Optional subtle shadow (shadow-sm) on hover.

component_instructions.general: Rely on Shadcn UI but customize to be flat and generously spaced. Remove border-radius if desired or keep small (rounded-md).
component_instructions.buttons: Solid brand color for primary, flat off-white for secondary. Never use Inter. Apply hover states.
component_instructions.inputs: Use Shadcn inputs, wide padding, clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#166534]/50 focus:border-[#166534]).
component_instructions.tables: Row hover effects (hover:bg-[#F5F5F4]). Avoid vertical borders inside the table. Clear text hierarchy for numbers (tabular-nums).
component_instructions.cards: Cardless or very subtle flat cards. No glassmorphism. Flat solid surfaces only to maintain data clarity.

testing.attributes: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).

icons.style: Minimalist, matching text size, usually 20px or 24px.

media_urls.description: Contemporary apartment blocks showcasing modern architectural design. Use for login screen split-layout background with an overlay (bg-black/20) for branding.
Minimalist abstract scene with geometric shapes in sage green. Use as a soft, calming empty-state visual for 'No overdue payments' or 'No expenses found'.

feature_notes.dashboard: Top row KPI cards for YTD Income, YTD Expenses, Current Balance, Overdue Payments.
feature_notes.navigation: Side or top nav. Keep it simple. Visible links: Dashboard, Units/Owners, Fees, Expenses, Budget, Comm Log, Compliance.
feature_notes.compliance_checklist: Use standard Shadcn Checkbox list for Illinois NFP and IRS 1120-H/990 steps.
